title: Synthetic monitor: api-gateway p95 vs recommendation-service deadline
symptoms: elevated 5xx rate on the alerting service
circuit breaker or retry storms toward one dependency
gateway returned 502/504 for a subset of routes
read/connect timeouts naming a downstream host
elevated p95 latency on the alerting service
observed_signals: error rate rose after outbound calls started timing out
caller CPU and memory stayed close to baseline
retries increased request rate slightly without a user-traffic surge
timeout logs named a specific dependency, not the local database

timeline.event: a batch window started on recommendation-service
outbound p95 from api-gateway toward recommendation-service rose
circuit breaker or retry logs referenced recommendation-service
fallback served cached responses until recommendation-service recovered

contributing_factors: a batch job on recommendation-service consumed the dependency's capacity
resolution: paused the batch job that was overloading recommendation-service
spread the job and added a shared rate limit
documented the dependency SLO in the caller runbook
lessons_learned: retry storms can look like a traffic surge on the caller
held DB connections during a slow downstream call are a side effect of waiting, not a saturated local pool
